props.title: Reporting without report theater
props.subtitle: Replace AI branding and report construction with current decisions, operating understanding, and durable records.
props.meta: Fleet Dashboard · Fleet Mobile · Consumer Mobile · 24 August 2026

props.content: The current page is not a reporting product. It is a feature dump: provider status, nine report modes, live metrics, voyage tools, debriefs, forecasts, exports, and three incompatible Ask behaviors. The actual report is below the first viewport. The replacement begins with the operator's moment, not the implementation.

props.label: Ruling
props.title: Retire the concept, not just the labels
props.subtitle: AI Reports should disappear from navigation. Reports become outputs of views that are already useful.

props.title: Delete AI Reports
props.content: Keep one historical decision workspace named Fleet performance. Put daily exceptions in Today. Put frozen artifacts in Records. Remove Generate, provider badges, progress stages, narration state, and report-page Ask.
props.next: Prototype Today, Fleet performance, and Records against the existing real-user study tasks.

props.title: Evidence boundary
props.content: Repository and Notion sources agree on the direction, but the direct personas are synthetic and no reporting or analytics usability session has run. This is an implementation hypothesis, not market or adoption proof.

props.label: Current state
props.title: The UI exposes implementation residue
props.subtitle: These are product-model defects, not isolated copy defects.

rows.observed: ReportView begins after the full console, summary, tools, KPI, chart, and voyage table.
rows.consequence: The first viewport contains no report and report tabs look inert.

rows.observed: The complete document already exists; the button requests optional prose.
rows.consequence: Provider narration is presented as report completion.

rows.observed: UI says signed and tamper-proof; backend stores and recomputes a hash without a signing key or external anchor.
rows.consequence: Integrity is confused with identity and attestation.

rows.observed: Live state, nine report types, voyage creation, debriefs, saved records, outlook, export, and Q&A coexist.
rows.consequence: Users cannot predict where to start or when they are done.

rows.observed: Selected-boat distance and voyages sit beside fleet-wide alerts and report content.
rows.consequence: Users cannot tell which controls govern which data.

rows.observed: Structured content renders, optional prose starts automatically, and the whole body may be replaced.
rows.consequence: The same inputs can create different saved artifacts depending on timing.

rows.observed: The READMEs are byte-identical and the report screens differ by only a few lines.
rows.consequence: Members inherit fleet concepts without an independent product or research basis.

rows.observed: Dashboard passage reports persist in browser local storage.
rows.consequence: A local artifact can be mistaken for a shared record.

props.title: Each mode has one completion condition

props.label: Minutes and hours
props.title: Operate
props.content: Today shows exposed departures, reasons, owners, deadlines, recovery options, and member impact. The work is complete when an accountable action is underway or closed.

props.label: Weeks and seasons
props.title: Understand
props.content: Fleet performance compares outcomes, utilization, reliability, safety, fuel, cost, and bounded outlooks. The work is complete when the reviewer can identify the material driver and decision.

props.label: Audit and sharing
props.title: Record
props.content: Records preserve the visible scope, source refresh time, coverage, and evidence. The work is complete when another authorized person can verify what was known and shared.

props.content: Outlook is a mode inside the relevant topic, not a report type. Every projection shows horizon, refreshed time, supporting inputs, missing coverage, uncertainty, and a route to the booking, vessel, or work item.

props.title: Interaction rules
props.content: Data appears immediately. Scope and period update the heading, URL, metrics, chart, table, and export together. Recommendations link to owned actions or disappear. Outlook is explicit. Evidence is inspectable without chat.

props.label: Mobile direction
props.title: Fleet and Consumer are different products
props.subtitle: Shared presentation does not mean shared journeys.

props.label: Fleet Mobile
props.title: Action in seconds
props.content: Today opens on readiness and the top three risks. Performance supports compact weekly or vessel review. Records contains saved snapshots and evidence. Primary actions route to vessel, booking, alert, or work.

props.label: Consumer Mobile
props.title: My boat and my trips
props.content: My Boat shows next-outing readiness and what changed. Trips contains automatic recaps. Documents contains evidence and exports. Fleet custody, renter conduct, rotation, and whole-fleet reports stay out until research proves a consumer job.

props.label: Validation
props.title: Acceptance is task completion, not taste
props.subtitle: The existing study plan already defines the real-user gate.

rows.pass: Operator answers boat, reason, owner, substitute, and member contact in under two minutes.
Top risk is understood and assigned in under 45 seconds, one-handed, including offline state.
User opens the required current or prior-period view and exports it without instruction.
User identifies observed inputs, projection horizon, missing data, and one uncertainty.
User identifies denominator and local override reason without facilitator help.
Canonical tasks complete equally or faster without a composer or transcript.
Repo and Notion both reject AI and dashboard-led positioning.
Six to eight participants complete the defined task set with zero critical honesty errors and final-round unassisted completion at or above the planned gate.

props.label: Independent review
props.title: Fable and five specialists converged
props.subtitle: The controller kept the evidence and rejected the report-centric residue.

props.label: Claude Fable 5 Max
props.title: Confirmed the structural diagnosis
props.content: Nineteen artifacts independently verified that the report exists before Generate, provider vocabulary leaked into UX, report Ask is a fake transcript, persistence is fragmented, and forecast machinery is buried across the product.

props.label: Controller review
props.title: Four conclusions were corrected
props.content: Current hashing does not justify signing or tamper claims. Mobile report-to-chat is not a safe pattern. A top-level Reports route stays too report-centric. The final pipeline gate is reframe, not proceed.
